This explains the extremely low compute throughput (12.48%) and achieved occupancy (6.25%). Tensor Cores deliver ~8x the throughput of FP32 FFMA for matrix multiply. K=480 is large enough that TF32 mantissa reduction (23->10 bits) may introduce small numerical error, but this kernel is fused with batch_norm/hardtanh (not a pure precision-critical GEMM), making TF32 acceptable. The scheduler shows only 13.9% eligible warps due to MIO stalls from bank conflicts - Tensor Core execution will reduce these stalls.
